sentences.text: This bail application is filed under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.532/2024 of Upputhara Police Station, Idukki,
registered for the offences punishable under sections 376, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'IPC'), and Section 3 r/w Section 4, Section 5(l) r/w Section 6(1), Section 7 r/w Section 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for short 'POCSO Act').
3.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: According to the prosecution, the petitioner enticed the victim into engaging in sexual relations by making a false promise of marriage, stating that he would marry her in a temple located in Jharkhand.

It is further alleged that during the period from April 2024 to May 2024, the petitioner and the victim engaged in sexual intercourse on multiple occasions, and thereby the accused committed the offences alleged.
Petitioner was arrested on 27.09.2024, and he has been in custody since then.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Public Prosecutor.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since 27.09.2024.
6. Since the victim is 16 years old, a notice was directed to be served on her through the Station House Officer.

7. When the learned Public Prosecutor submitted that notice to the victim has been served on 02.07.2025 at Jharkhand, this Court had adjourned this application to today as a measure of granting a breathing time to the victim to appear, if required.
However, there is no appearance for the victim.
8. Petitioner is alleged to have indulged in penetrative sexual intercourse with the victim on multiple occasions.
The victim being only 16 years of age, the allegations are very serious.
However, the petitioner is also a youngster aged only 25 years, and he has been in custody for almost ten months.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the period of detention already undergone, and also bearing in mind the young age of the petitioner, I am of the view that further custody of the petitioner is not warranted.

Moreover,
final report of the case has already been filed on 23.11.2024, and there is no possibility of the petitioner influencing the witnesses, since it is stated that the victim has already moved to Jharkhand and is residing there.
Therefore, the petitioner is entitled to be released on bail.

In the result, this application is allowed on the following conditions:-
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.
(b) Petitioner shall co-operate with the trial of the case.
(c) Petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses; nor shall he attempt to tamper with the evidence or contact the victim or her family members.
(d) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.
(e) Petitioner shall not leave the State of Kerala until the conclusion of trial.

In case of violation of any of the above conditions or if any modification or deletion of the conditions are required, the jurisdictional Court shall be empowered to consider such applications, if any, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with the law, notwithstanding the bail having been granted by this Court.

Sd/-
